description: This file contains an extension for VoiceWakeOverlayController, implementing various methods related to managing voice wake overlay sessions, including starting, updating, presenting, dismissing, and handling state changes in a voice recognition UI component.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and starts a voice wake session with provided parameters, updating the model state and initiating UI presentation.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session state including token, source, text, and visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the overlay with partial transcription data, resetting relevant state flags.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the overlay with final transcript, optionally schedules auto-send, and adjusts UI accordingly.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Sets the model state to editing mode, canceling auto-send if necessary.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels editing state and dismisses the overlay UI explicitly.

methods.name: endEditing
methods.description: Ends editing mode without dismissing the overlay.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay text and refreshes the UI window frame.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Transitions the overlay into sending state, optionally playing a chime, and schedules dismissal.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests immediate sending of the current transcript via the session coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Handles dismissing the overlay UI with animations, state resets, and callbacks to cleanup and notify other components.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator, respecting rate limiting via last update timestamp.

methods.name: guardToken
methods.description: Verifies if the provided token matches the active token for the overlay session.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Determines if an incoming token should be accepted or rejected based on current active token.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an auto-send task to execute after a specified delay, handling cancellation if needed.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with standard styling.
